# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:50:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

All CI checks passed on the rework head (or no check reported a failure).

- `ci_failures_full.log` will not exist when nothing failed.
- If CI was expected to be red, re-check the PR checks page — this file was

A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.

- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 451

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: extsize trigger set misses root `vendor/**` (and `scripts/size_manifest.py`)**

The classifier arm at this line covers `browser_ext/` (incl. the `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` engine lock), `flutter_app/`, `lib/`, `packages/`, pubspec files, the packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but **not** the root `vendor/` tree. The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

- `pubspec.yaml:88` → `vendor/xterm` (compiles into `sw/agent.js`)
- `pubspec_overrides.yaml` → `vendor/dart_tui`
- `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml:242-287` → `../vendor/wasm_run`, `../vendor/wasm_run_flutter`, `../vendor/flutter_inappwebview_*` (compile into the panel app web build)

Path deps carry no content hash in `pubspec.lock`, so a PR that edits vendored fork source (this repo pins *patched* forks — patch edits are a normal maintenance event) can move the zip manifest with **no covered path touched**: the PR gate skips, and the regression resurfaces only at the release leg — the exact merge-then-red failure mode gh-1684 exists to kill. `pages.yml` still triggers on `vendor/**` for the same reason (the web build consumes the forks).

Suggested fix — add `^vendor/` to the alternation:

```yaml
grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'
```

Second, smaller gap in the same set: `scripts/size_manifest.py` itself is not a trigger. A PR changing only the enforcement tool (rev normalization, budget math) never arms the gate that runs it. Consider adding `^scripts/size_manifest\.py$` (or broadening to `^scripts/size_budget/` + the tool).

- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:50:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 451

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: extsize trigger set misses root `vendor/**` (and `scripts/size_manifest.py`)**

The classifier arm at this line covers `browser_ext/` (incl. the `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` engine lock), `flutter_app/`, `lib/`, `packages/`, pubspec files, the packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but **not** the root `vendor/` tree. The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

- `pubspec.yaml:88` → `vendor/xterm` (compiles into `sw/agent.js`)
- `pubspec_overrides.yaml` → `vendor/dart_tui`
- `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml:242-287` → `../vendor/wasm_run`, `../vendor/wasm_run_flutter`, `../vendor/flutter_inappwebview_*` (compile into the panel app web build)

Path deps carry no content hash in `pubspec.lock`, so a PR that edits vendored fork source (this repo pins *patched* forks — patch edits are a normal maintenance event) can move the zip manifest with **no covered path touched**: the PR gate skips, and the regression resurfaces only at the release leg — the exact merge-then-red failure mode gh-1684 exists to kill. `pages.yml` still triggers on `vendor/**` for the same reason (the web build consumes the forks).

Suggested fix — add `^vendor/` to the alternation:

```yaml
grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'
```

Second, smaller gap in the same set: `scripts/size_manifest.py` itself is not a trigger. A PR changing only the enforcement tool (rev normalization, budget math) never arms the gate that runs it. Consider adding `^scripts/size_manifest\.py$` (or broadening to `^scripts/size_budget/` + the tool).

Severity rationale: the primary regression vector from #1631 (browser_ext vendored engines) is covered, and the fail-safe merge-base arm still over-triggers rather than under-triggers — the shipped gate works for the common paths, which is why this is filed at IMPORTANT severity.

With the Pages build/copy removed (AC1), the zip is built per **release** by `build-macos.yml` `build-extension` and per PR by the `extension-size-gate` leg — deploys no longer touch it. Suggest:

```

```

Same class of wording survives at line 52-54 of this file only; `site/index.html` was fully consistent.

---

### Thread 3 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 2240

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: enable the Flutter SDK cache on the new gate leg**

This leg re-downloads the full Flutter 3.47.7 SDK on every run. 11 of the 15 other `subosito/flutter-action` steps in `ci.yml` set `cache: true` (e.g. the `office-addin-suite` leg this job was modeled on). **ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: extsize trigger set — two zip-moving paths are not armed**

The classifier covers extension sources, vendor lock, packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but two paths that can still move the `fa-extension.zip` manifest do not arm the gate:

1. `scripts/size_manifest.py` — the gate implementation itself. A change here (budget math, `is_vendored` first-party split, NEW-line share) can relax enforcement without the leg re-running. - **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:50:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 451

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: extsize trigger set misses root `vendor/**` (and `scripts/size_manifest.py`)**

The classifier arm at this line covers `browser_ext/` (incl. the `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` engine lock), `flutter_app/`, `lib/`, `packages/`, pubspec files, the packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but **not** the root `vendor/` tree. The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

- `pubspec.yaml:88` → `vendor/xterm` (compiles into `sw/agent.js`)
- `pubspec_overrides.yaml` → `vendor/dart_tui`
- `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml:242-287` → `../vendor/wasm_run`, `../vendor/wasm_run_flutter`, `../vendor/flutter_inappwebview_*` (compile into the panel app web build)

Path deps carry no content hash in `pubspec.lock`, so a PR that edits vendored fork source (this repo pins *patched* forks — patch edits are a normal maintenance event) can move the zip manifest with **no covered path touched**: the PR gate skips, and the regression resurfaces only at the release leg — the exact merge-then-red failure mode gh-1684 exists to kill. `pages.yml` still triggers on `vendor/**` for the same reason (the web build consumes the forks).

Suggested fix — add `^vendor/` to the alternation:

```yaml
grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'
```

Second, smaller gap in the same set: `scripts/size_manifest.py` itself is not a trigger. A PR changing only the enforcement tool (rev normalization, budget math) never arms the gate that runs it. Consider adding `^scripts/size_manifest\.py$` (or broadening to `^scripts/size_budget/` + the tool).

Severity rationale: the primary regression vector from #1631 (browser_ext vendored engines) is covered, and the fail-safe merge-base arm still over-triggers rather than under-triggers — the shipped gate works for the common paths, which is why this is filed at IMPORTANT severity.

With the Pages build/copy removed (AC1), the zip is built per **release** by `build-macos.yml` `build-extension` and per PR by the `extension-size-gate` leg — deploys no longer touch it. Suggest:

```

```

Same class of wording survives at line 52-54 of this file only; `site/index.html` was fully consistent.

---

### Thread 3 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 2240

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: enable the Flutter SDK cache on the new gate leg**

This leg re-downloads the full Flutter 3.47.7 SDK on every run. 11 of the 15 other `subosito/flutter-action` steps in `ci.yml` set `cache: true` (e.g. the `office-addin-suite` leg this job was modeled on). **ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: extsize trigger set — two zip-moving paths are not armed**

The classifier covers extension sources, vendor lock, packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but two paths that can still move the `fa-extension.zip` manifest do not arm the gate:

1. `scripts/size_manifest.py` — the gate implementation itself. A change here (budget math, `is_vendored` first-party split, NEW-line share) can relax enforcement without the leg re-running. Closes #1684

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'

Settings-gated second-tier
  tools that surface once the user enables them:
  `browser_search`, `top_sites`, `reading_list`, `page_capture`.
- Entry points: the side panel, the omnibox (`fa <query>`), the
  Ctrl+Shift+1 hotkey, and the context menu on any selection. Page-derived
  content is quarantined as untrusted data. `inject_js` prompts on every
  call in every session mode by default — explicitly switching the
  session to yolo drops that guard (the override is cleared, not
  bypassed silently).
- Artifact (rebuilt on every deploy):
  https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip — unzip, then open
  chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked, pick the
  unzipped folder.
- Architecture and operations: `docs/browser-extension.md` in the repository.

## Outlook add-in

content.text:
steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:50:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 451

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: extsize trigger set misses root `vendor/**` (and `scripts/size_manifest.py`)**

The classifier arm at this line covers `browser_ext/` (incl. the `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` engine lock), `flutter_app/`, `lib/`, `packages/`, pubspec files, the packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but **not** the root `vendor/` tree. The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

- `pubspec.yaml:88` → `vendor/xterm` (compiles into `sw/agent.js`)
- `pubspec_overrides.yaml` → `vendor/dart_tui`
- `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml:242-287` → `../vendor/wasm_run`, `../vendor/wasm_run_flutter`, `../vendor/flutter_inappwebview_*` (compile into the panel app web build)

Path deps carry no content hash in `pubspec.lock`, so a PR that edits vendored fork source (this repo pins *patched* forks — patch edits are a normal maintenance event) can move the zip manifest with **no covered path touched**: the PR gate skips, and the regression resurfaces only at the release leg — the exact merge-then-red failure mode gh-1684 exists to kill. `pages.yml` still triggers on `vendor/**` for the same reason (the web build consumes the forks).

Suggested fix — add `^vendor/` to the alternation:

```yaml
grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'
```

Second, smaller gap in the same set: `scripts/size_manifest.py` itself is not a trigger. A PR changing only the enforcement tool (rev normalization, budget math) never arms the gate that runs it. Consider adding `^scripts/size_manifest\.py$` (or broadening to `^scripts/size_budget/` + the tool).

Severity rationale: the primary regression vector from #1631 (browser_ext vendored engines) is covered, and the fail-safe merge-base arm still over-triggers rather than under-triggers — the shipped gate works for the common paths, which is why this is filed at IMPORTANT severity.

With the Pages build/copy removed (AC1), the zip is built per **release** by `build-macos.yml` `build-extension` and per PR by the `extension-size-gate` leg — deploys no longer touch it. Suggest:

```

```

Same class of wording survives at line 52-54 of this file only; `site/index.html` was fully consistent.

---

### Thread 3 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 2240

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: enable the Flutter SDK cache on the new gate leg**

This leg re-downloads the full Flutter 3.47.7 SDK on every run. 11 of the 15 other `subosito/flutter-action` steps in `ci.yml` set `cache: true` (e.g. the `office-addin-suite` leg this job was modeled on). **ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
💡 **SUGGESTION: extsize trigger set — two zip-moving paths are not armed**

The classifier covers extension sources, vendor lock, packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but two paths that can still move the `fa-extension.zip` manifest do not arm the gate:

1. `scripts/size_manifest.py` — the gate implementation itself. A change here (budget math, `is_vendored` first-party split, NEW-line share) can relax enforcement without the leg re-running. ## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

Settings-gated second-tier
  tools that surface once the user enables them:
  `browser_search`, `top_sites`, `reading_list`, `page_capture`.
- Entry points: the side panel, the omnibox (`fa <query>`), the
  Ctrl+Shift+1 hotkey, and the context menu on any selection. Page-derived
  content is quarantined as untrusted data. `inject_js` prompts on every
  call in every session mode by default — explicitly switching the
  session to yolo drops that guard (the override is cleared, not
  bypassed silently).
- Artifact (rebuilt on every deploy):
  https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip — unzip, then open
  chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked, pick the
  unzipped folder.

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.

```yaml

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other

          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)

          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122

- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:50:15Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# PR Discussion History

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 451

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-20):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: extsize trigger set misses root `vendor/**` (and `scripts/size_manifest.py`)**

The classifier arm at this line covers `browser_ext/` (incl. the `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` engine lock), `flutter_app/`, `lib/`, `packages/`, pubspec files, the packaging scripts, the baseline TSV and the three workflows — but **not** the root `vendor/` tree. The vendored forks are real build inputs of the gated artifact:

- `pubspec.yaml:88` → `vendor/xterm` (compiles into `sw/agent.js`)
- `pubspec_overrides.yaml` → `vendor/dart_tui`
- `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml:242-287` → `../vendor/wasm_run`, `../vendor/wasm_run_flutter`, `../vendor/flutter_inappwebview_*` (compile into the panel app web build)

Path deps carry no content hash in `pubspec.lock`, so a PR that edits vendored fork source (this repo pins *patched* forks — patch edits are a normal maintenance event) can move the zip manifest with **no covered path touched**: the PR gate skips, and the regression resurfaces only at the release leg — the exact merge-then-red failure mode gh-1684 exists to kill. `pages.yml` still triggers on `vendor/**` for the same reason (the web build consumes the forks).

Suggested fix — add `^vendor/` to the alternation:

```yaml
grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|...'
```

Second, smaller gap in the same set: `scripts/size_manifest.py` itself is not a trigger. A PR changing only the enforcement tool (rev normalization, budget math) never arms the gate that runs it. Consider adding `^scripts/size_manifest\.py$` (or broadening to `^scripts/size_budget/` + the tool).

```

Same class of wording survives at line 52-54 of this file only; `site/index.html` was fully consistent.

      - name: Build extension zip
